summary: tailwindcss-contact-forms typosquat ships obfuscated blockchain-C2 loader in main
details: Package name mimics @tailwindcss/forms and package.json falsely points `repository` at `github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms`, but src/index.js (the `main`, executed on require/import) is a heavily obfuscated obfuscator.io-style bundle with `_0x`-hex identifiers and a rotating string array — no legitimate function for a static CSS plugin. On load the code imports `node:child_process` to obtain `spawn`, assigns `require` and `module` to `global` (`global.r`, `global.m`) to expose the module loader for dynamically constructed code, and issues Ethereum JSON-RPC calls (`eth_blockNumber`, `eth_getBlockByNumber`, `eth_getTransactionCount`) plus an Etherscan-style txlist scan against a hardcoded address (assembled from string-array fragments as `0xa322E5f39aDC2490EfD311D3080e6f0121063e1a`) via multiple hardcoded RPC providers (drpc.org, publicnode.com, blockscout) and `process.env.ETH_RPC_URL`. Custom `x-payload-` / `Payload-B6` headers and a nonce fanout accompany the traffic. The shape — an on-chain read of an attacker-controlled address at import time, in a package whose advertised purpose is CSS configuration — is a blockchain-mediated C2 channel used to fetch further payload/URL instructions and execute them through the exposed `require`/`spawn` plumbing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
